messages:
sam: Heads-up: got a page from na-west services about sudden mTLS handshake rejects at ~08:10 UTC. proxies show cert-fetch failures.
viv: looking now. logs show KMS DecryptDenied but with a condition mention: `condition: attr.region == \"eu\"`. weird.
nora: who modified KMS key policy? we recently tightened bindings to limit decrypt to region-scoped SAs. suspect that change.
sam: snippet from rotator: 
```
2026-03-24T08:09:58Z cert-rotator ERROR: unwrap failed: PermissionDenied: requestor serviceAccount:svc-ca@infra -> KMS policy condition mismatch (attr.region!=\"eu\")
```
viv: yeah that means the key IAM has a condition restricting decrypt to requests labeled region=eu. our cert-rotator runs in multiple regions and doesn't set that attr.
audit-bot: policy-change detected: user=ops-sweep@redwood removed binding 'roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' for group=eng-platform-legacy and added conditional binding to principal=serviceAccount:svc-ca@infra with condition `request.attribute.region == \"eu\"`. change ts=2026-03-24T07:58:10Z.
nora: immediate mitigation: can we remove the condition or add a complementary binding for na-west/apac? what's safest short-term?
sam: safest immediate is to re-add an unconditional decrypt binding for the cert key but narrow to the cert-rotator SA only. doing: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ingress --location=global --keyring=edge-kr --member=serviceAccount:svc-ca@infra --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
kms-bot: IAM binding applied (op:kb-2203) at 08:14:07Z.
viv: cert jobs retry and I see successful unwraps starting 08:16:02Z. edge mTLS handshake success recovered by 08:17. brief outage window ~7 minutes.
sam: confirm root cause: a policy author added a region condition thinking keys were region-specific; but our attribute labeling pipeline didn't inject attr.region on all requests.
nora: follow-ups: 1) add a CI gate that simulates KMS decrypt with affected SA across regions when changing KMS IAM (kms-impact-check), 2) mandate that KMS conditional bindings must include a fallback binding for cert-rotator SA unless explicit per-region attributes are present, 3) instrument SDK to send request attributes or deny-conditions must be avoided for cross-region cert ops.
audit-bot: creating ticket SEC-2026-421 with timeline, diffs, and mitigation steps. https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-421
viv: also recommend an observability rule: if any KMS key binding gains a condition (bindings[].condition != null) -> run `kms-impact-check` and create a temp alert for 1h blocking merges.
sam: for the postmortem, we should add a snippet for quick rollback: 
```bash
# revert conditional binding on key
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ingress --location=global --keyring=edge-kr --member=serviceAccount:svc-ca@infra --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition=None
# or re-add unconditional binding for svc-ca@infra
```
viv: I'll add the CI hook and a small unit-test that calls `iam.simulate` for the SA against the key prior to merging. nora, can you lead the policy wording update?
nora: yes, will draft policy: "No conditional KMS binding that restricts cert operators without an explicit cross-region plan." will attach to ticket.
deploy-bot: rollback PR ops/rbac/2244 executed (canary=false) T=08:20:40Z.
audit-bot: attached relevant audit log slice, policy diff, and recover timeline to SEC-2026-421.
sam: thanks team. closing thread once CI rule merges and the ticket has owners. :lock:
